title: A must do
text: Great experience. Our guide was very knowledgeable and kind. She didn’t talk too much (some guides start rambling). It was raining and it was cold so she was quick when we were outside. I definitely recommend this tour. After she was done we were able to go back inside and walk around. Absolutely beautiful
author: Karen_M

title: Tina was a great guide
text: Tina was a great guide thank you Tina. You lead everybody a big group so well really took control. We loved your feather pole.
author: Caroline_S

title: Great day with Marta
text: Marta was such a great guide and super knowledgeable. Would definitely recommend her.
author: dustinhA1407HB

title: Amazing tour, highly recommend
text: Me and my boyfriend went on a guided tour of Sagrada Família. We’ve never done a guided tour like this but will definitely be booking more!! We had Jose as our tour guide he was very knowledgeable learnt a lot more facts from him than if we went alone. The tour was super engaging and Jose made it very fun and comfortable. We were with a group of around 10 other guest who were also very kind. It was great that we could stay as long as we wanted after the tour as we could take in the atmosphere and revisit some areas again
author: 396alannahb

title: Sagrada Familia

author: 413pranavm

title: Excellent tour w/ Jose!
text: Jose was a fantastic guide who made our visit to the Sagrada Familia both informative and enjoyable. His explanations of Gaudí’s vision, the architectural details, and the religious symbolism gave us a much greater appreciation for the basilica than we would have had visiting on our own. The 90-minute tour was well worth it. Highly recommend this experience, especially with Jose as your guide!
author: jonathanhunterf
